question.nothing_to_save: There are no funds available to save right now, because all balance above your reserve and upcoming bills is already committed.

rejection.shape: The request could not be converted into a valid payment, so processing stopped.
rejection.raw_address: The request contained an explicit account address. Payments to unverified addresses provided directly in requests are not permitted, so processing stopped.
rejection.wallet_frozen: Your wallet is frozen, so no funds can be sent until you unfreeze it.
rejection.unknown_payee: That payee is not on your list, so I cannot pay them. You can add them on the payee page.
rejection.inactive_payee: That payee is not active. Adding or restoring a payee always requires waiting for the loosening delay.
rejection.label_mismatch: The payee name in the draft did not match the name on your list, so processing stopped.
rejection.unsourced_payee: The payee could not be traced back to your message, the mandate, or a provided document, so processing stopped.
rejection.unsourced_amount: The amount could not be traced back to your message, the mandate, or a provided document, so processing stopped.
rejection.obligation_mismatch: The bill requested for settlement does not belong to that payee, so processing stopped.
rejection.malformed_schedule: The schedule is not valid. It must repeat at least once a day and start in the future.
rejection.insufficient_balance: The wallet balance is insufficient to cover that amount.
rejection.unsourced_schedule: The payment frequency and count could not be verified from your message, so processing stopped.
rejection.contradictory_instruction: Your message contains conflicting instructions to pay and not to pay, so no action was taken. Please clarify your intention.
mission.problem.limits_out_of_order: Your configured limits are inconsistent. The amount permitted autonomously must not exceed the daily limit or the amount allowed with a delay.
mission.problem.delay_out_of_range: The delay for larger payments must be greater than zero and at most 30 days.
mission.problem.loosening_delay_out_of_r: The delay before loosening must be greater than zero and at most 30 days.
mission.problem.hold_out_of_range: The hold period under pressure must be greater than zero and at most 7 days.
mission.problem.not_owner_signed: The mandate was not signed by the owner of this wallet, so it was not saved.
mission.problem.unsupported_chain: This network is not a permitted test network.
mission.problem.wrong_target: The signed mandate specifies a different wallet or network, so it was not saved.

mandate.d1: I may pay up to {amount} MockUSD autonomously in one day.

explain.safe_now.capsule.l3: The safety check held this payment of {amount} MockUSD because it matches shared alert number {capsule}, so it requires your approval and you can cancel it at any time.
explain.allowance.l2: The caution allowance held this payment of {amount} MockUSD because the daily allowance has been exhausted, so it will wait {delay} and you can cancel it before release.
explain.allowance.l3: The caution allowance held this payment of {amount} MockUSD because the daily allowance has been exhausted, so it requires your approval and you can cancel it at any time.
